hook.text: When a tweet gets more replies than likes, it's been 'ratioed.' The crowd has spoken: you're wrong.

buildup.text: The ratio became a weapon. People pile on not to argue but to increase the gap. Cruelty is the sport.

discovery.text: Quote-tweets amplify the original to hostile audiences. Each quote adds mockery for a new crowd.

twist.text: Platforms could hide ratios or limit quote-tweets. Some tested it. Engagement dropped, so they stopped.

climax.text: The ratio turns disagreement into spectacle. You don't debate—you perform dominance for an audience.

punchline.text: The ratio isn't feedback. It's a public execution.

quiz.question: What does getting 'ratioed' on social media mean?
